items.source: The org.springframework.web.server package builds on the HttpHandler contract to provide a general-purpose web API for processing requests through a chain of multiple WebExceptionHandler, multiple WebFilter, and a single WebHandler component. The chain can be put together with WebHttpHandlerBuilder by simply pointing to a Spring ApplicationContext where components are auto-detected, and/or by registering components with the builder.
items.translation: The org.springframework.web.server 包基于 HttpHandler 契约，提供用于通过多个 WebExceptionHandler、多个 WebFilter 以及单个 WebHandler 组件处理请求的通用 Web API。该链可以通过简单地指向 Spring ApplicationContext（其中组件会被 自动检测）和/或通过向构建器注册组件，使用 WebHttpHandlerBuilder 进行组装。

items.source: The DefaultServerWebExchange uses the configured HttpMessageReader<MultiValueMap<String, Part>> to parse multipart/form-data, multipart/mixed, and multipart/related content into a MultiValueMap. By default, this is the DefaultPartHttpMessageReader, which does not have any third-party dependencies. Alternatively, the SynchronossPartHttpMessageReader can be used, which is based on the Synchronoss NIO Multipart library. Both are configured through the ServerCodecConfigurer bean (see the Web Handler API).
items.translation: DefaultServerWebExchange 使用配置的HttpMessageReader<MultiValueMap<String, Part>>将multipart/form-data、multipart/mixed和multipart/related内容解析为MultiValueMap。默认情况下，这是DefaultPartHttpMessageReader，它没有任何第三方依赖。或者，可以使用基于Synchronoss NIO Multipart库的SynchronossPartHttpMessageReader。两者都通过ServerCodecConfigurerbean 进行配置（参见Web Handler API）。

items.source: MultipartHttpMessageReader and MultipartHttpMessageWriter support decoding and encoding "multipart/form-data", "multipart/mixed", and "multipart/related" content. In turn MultipartHttpMessageReader delegates to another HttpMessageReader for the actual parsing to a Flux<Part> and then simply collects the parts into a MultiValueMap. By default, the DefaultPartHttpMessageReader is used, but this can be changed through the ServerCodecConfigurer. For more information about the DefaultPartHttpMessageReader, refer to the javadoc of DefaultPartHttpMessageReader.
items.translation: MultipartHttpMessageReader 和 MultipartHttpMessageWriter 支持解码和编码 "multipart/form-data"、"multipart/mixed" 以及 "multipart/related" 内容。MultipartHttpMessageReader 进而委托给另一个 HttpMessageReader 进行实际解析，生成一个 Flux<Part>，然后简单地将这些部分收集到一个 MultiValueMap 中。默认情况下，使用 DefaultPartHttpMessageReader，但可以通过 ServerCodecConfigurer 进行更改。有关 DefaultPartHttpMessageReader 的更多信息，请参阅其 javadoc of DefaultPartHttpMessageReader。

items.source: In the WebHandler API, you can use a WebExceptionHandler to handle exceptions from the chain of WebFilter instances and the target WebHandler. When using the WebFlux Config, registering a WebExceptionHandler is as simple as declaring it as a Spring bean and (optionally) expressing precedence by using @Order on the bean declaration or by implementing Ordered.
items.translation: 在WebHandler API中，您可以使用WebExceptionHandler来处理来自WebFilter实例链和目标WebHandler的异常。在使用WebFlux 配置时，注册WebExceptionHandler只需将其声明为 Spring Bean，并（可选地）通过在 Bean 声明上使用@Order或实现Ordered来表达优先级。

items.source: On the server side, the log ID is stored in the ServerWebExchange attribute (LOG_ID_ATTRIBUTE), while a fully formatted prefix based on that ID is available from ServerWebExchange#getLogPrefix(). On the WebClient side, the log ID is stored in the ClientRequest attribute (LOG_ID_ATTRIBUTE) ,while a fully formatted prefix is available from ClientRequest#logPrefix().
items.translation: 在服务器端，日志 ID 存储在 ServerWebExchange 属性中（LOG_ID_ATTRIBUTE），而基于该 ID 的完整格式化前缀可从 ServerWebExchange#getLogPrefix() 获取。在 WebClient 端，日志 ID 存储在 ClientRequest 属性中（LOG_ID_ATTRIBUTE），而完整格式化前缀可从 ClientRequest#logPrefix() 获取。

items.source: While not standard, X-Forwarded-Host: <host> is a de-facto standard header that is used to communicate the original host to a downstream server. For example, if a request of example.com/resource is sent to a proxy which forwards the request to localhost:8080/resource, then a header of X-Forwarded-Host: example.com can be sent to inform the server that the original host was example.com.
items.translation: 虽然并非标准，但X-Forwarded-Host: <host>是一个事实上的标准标头，用于向下游服务器传达原始主机信息。例如，如果将 example.com/resource 的请求发送到代理服务器，该代理将其转发至 localhost:8080/resource，则可以发送一个标头X-Forwarded-Host: example.com，以告知服务器原始主机为example.com。

items.source: While not standard, X-Forwarded-Proto: (https|http) is a de-facto standard header that is used to communicate the original protocol (for example, https / http) to a downstream server. For example, if a request of example.com/resource is sent to a proxy which forwards the request to localhost:8080/resource, then a header of X-Forwarded-Proto: https can be sent to inform the server that the original protocol was https.
items.translation: 虽然并非标准，但X-Forwarded-Proto: (https|http)是一个事实上的标准标头，用于向下游服务器传达原始协议（例如 https / http）。例如，如果将 example.com/resource 的请求发送到代理服务器，该代理服务器再将请求转发到 localhost:8080/resource，则可以发送一个标头X-Forwarded-Proto: https，以告知服务器原始协议为https。

items.source: In the WebHandler API, you can use a WebFilter to apply interception-style logic before and after the rest of the processing chain of filters and the target WebHandler. When using the WebFlux Config, registering a WebFilter is as simple as declaring it as a Spring bean and (optionally) expressing precedence by using @Order on the bean declaration or by implementing Ordered.
items.translation: 在WebHandler API中，您可以使用WebFilter在过滤器和目标的其余处理链之前和之后应用拦截式逻辑。当使用WebFlux Config时，注册WebFilter只需将其声明为 Spring bean，并（可选）通过在 bean 声明上使用@Order或实现Ordered来表达优先级。

items.source: The DefaultServerWebExchange uses the configured HttpMessageReader to parse form data (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) into a MultiValueMap. By default, FormHttpMessageReader is configured for use by the ServerCodecConfigurer bean (see the Web Handler API).
items.translation: DefaultServerWebExchange 使用配置的 HttpMessageReader 将表单数据（application/x-www-form-urlencoded）解析为 MultiValueMap。默认情况下，FormHttpMessageReader 已配置供 ServerCodecConfigurer bean 使用（参见Web Handler API）。

items.source: To parse multipart data in streaming fashion, you can use the Flux<PartEvent> returned from the PartEventHttpMessageReader instead of using @RequestPart, as that implies Map-like access to individual parts by name and, hence, requires parsing multipart data in full. By contrast, you can use @RequestBody to decode the content to Flux<PartEvent> without collecting to a MultiValueMap.
items.translation: 要以流式方式解析多部分数据，您可以使用从PartEventHttpMessageReader返回的Flux<PartEvent>，而不是使用@RequestPart，因为后者意味着按名称以类似Map的方式访问各个部分，因此需要完全解析多部分数据。相比之下，您可以使用@RequestBody将内容解码为Flux<PartEvent>，而无需收集到MultiValueMap中。

items.source: While not standard, X-Forwarded-Port: <port> is a de-facto standard header that is used to communicate the original port to a downstream server. For example, if a request of example.com/resource is sent to a proxy which forwards the request to localhost:8080/resource, then a header of X-Forwarded-Port: 443 can be sent to inform the server that the original port was 443.
items.translation: 虽然并非标准，但 `X-Forwarded-Port: <port>` 是一个事实上的标准标头，用于向下游服务器传达原始端口。例如，如果将请求发送至代理服务器，该代理将其转发至 example.com/resource，则可以向服务器发送一个 `X-Forwarded-Port: 443` 标头，以告知服务器原始端口为 `443`。

items.source: While not standard, X-Forwarded-Ssl: (on|off) is a de-facto standard header that is used to communicate the original protocol (for example, https / https) to a downstream server. For example, if a request of example.com/resource is sent to a proxy which forwards the request to localhost:8080/resource, then a header of X-Forwarded-Ssl: on to inform the server that the original protocol was https.
items.translation: 虽然并非标准，但 `X-Forwarded-Ssl: (on|off)` 是一个事实上的标准标头，用于向下游服务器传达原始协议（例如，https / https）。例如，如果将请求发送至 example.com/resource 的代理，该代理再将请求转发至 localhost:8080/resource，则会发送标头 `X-Forwarded-Ssl: on` 以告知服务器原始协议为 `https`。

items.source: The proxy has no prefix, while applications app1 and app2 have path prefixes /app1 and /app2 respectively. The proxy can send X-Forwarded-Prefix: to have the empty prefix override server prefixes /app1 and /app2.
items.translation: 代理没有前缀，而应用程序app1和app2分别具有路径前缀/app1和/app2。代理可以发送X-Forwarded-Prefix: 以使用空前缀覆盖服务器前缀/app1和/app2。

items.source: The spring-core module provides byte[], ByteBuffer, DataBuffer, Resource, and String encoder and decoder implementations. The spring-web module provides Jackson JSON, Jackson Smile, JAXB2, Protocol Buffers and other encoders and decoders along with web-only HTTP message reader and writer implementations for form data, multipart content, server-sent events, and others.
items.translation: spring-core 模块提供了 byte[]、ByteBuffer、DataBuffer、Resource 和 String 的编码器与解码器实现。spring-web 模块提供了 Jackson JSON、Jackson Smile、JAXB2、Protocol Buffers 以及其他编码器与解码器，同时还提供了仅用于 Web 的 HTTP 消息读取器和写入器实现，支持表单数据、多部分内容、服务器发送事件等。

items.source: By default both Jackson2Encoder and Jackson2Decoder do not support elements of type String. Instead the default assumption is that a string or a sequence of strings represent serialized JSON content, to be rendered by the CharSequenceEncoder. If what you need is to render a JSON array from Flux<String>, use Flux#collectToList() and encode a Mono<List<String>>.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Jackson2Encoder 和 Jackson2Decoder 均不支持类型为 String 的元素。相反，默认假设字符串或字符串序列代表已序列化的 JSON 内容，将由 CharSequenceEncoder 进行渲染。如果您需要渲染来自 Flux<String> 的 JSON 数组，请使用 Flux#collectToList() 并编码一个 Mono<List<String>>。

items.source: There are other non-standard headers, too, including X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Port, X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Ssl, X-Forwarded-Prefix, and X-Forwarded-For.
items.translation: 还有其他非标准标头，包括 X-Forwarded-Host、X-Forwarded-Port、X-Forwarded-Proto、X-Forwarded-Ssl、X-Forwarded-Prefix 和 X-Forwarded-For。

items.source: The prefix is the start of the path before the capture group {path}. For the proxy, the prefix is /api while for the server the prefix is /app1. In this case, the proxy can send X-Forwarded-Prefix: /api to have the original prefix /api override the server prefix /app1.
items.translation: 前缀是捕获组{path}之前的路径起始部分。对于代理，前缀为/api，而对于服务器，前缀为/app1。在这种情况下，代理可以发送X-Forwarded-Prefix: /api，以使原始前缀/api覆盖服务器前缀/app1。

items.source: On the server side where form content often needs to be accessed from multiple places, ServerWebExchange provides a dedicated getFormData() method that parses the content through FormHttpMessageReader and then caches the result for repeated access. See Form Data in the WebHandler API section.
items.translation: 在服务器端，由于经常需要从多个位置访问表单内容，ServerWebExchange 提供了一个专用的 getFormData() 方法，该方法通过 FormHttpMessageReader 解析内容，然后将结果缓存起来以供重复访问。请参阅表单数据部分，该部分位于WebHandler API章节中。

items.source: On the server side where multipart form content may need to be accessed from multiple places, ServerWebExchange provides a dedicated getMultipartData() method that parses the content through MultipartHttpMessageReader and then caches the result for repeated access. See Multipart Data in the WebHandler API section.
items.translation: 在服务器端，当可能需要从多个位置访问 multipart 表单内容时，ServerWebExchange 提供了一个专用的 getMultipartData() 方法，该方法通过 MultipartHttpMessageReader 解析内容，然后将结果缓存起来以供重复访问。请参阅 Multipart Data（位于WebHandler API部分）。

items.source: Gson does not support non-blocking parsing, so the GsonDecoder does not support deserializing to Flux<*> types. For example, if this decoder is used for deserializing a JSON stream or even a list of elements as a Flux<*>, an UnsupportedOperationException will be thrown at runtime. Applications should instead focus on deserializing bounded collections and use Mono<List<*>> as target types.
items.translation: Gson 不支持非阻塞解析，因此 GsonDecoder 不支持反序列化为 Flux<*> 类型。例如，如果将此解码器用于将 JSON 流或元素列表反序列化为 Flux<*>，则在运行时将抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。应用程序应专注于反序列化有界集合，并使用 Mono<List<*>> 作为目标类型。

items.source: To configure buffer sizes, you can check if a given Decoder or HttpMessageReader exposes a maxInMemorySize property and if so the Javadoc will have details about default values. On the server side, ServerCodecConfigurer provides a single place from where to set all codecs, see HTTP message codecs. On the client side, the limit for all codecs can be changed in WebClient.Builder.
items.translation: 要配置缓冲区大小，您可以检查给定的 Decoder 或 HttpMessageReader 是否公开了 maxInMemorySize 属性；如果是，则 Javadoc 将提供有关默认值的详细信息。在服务器端，ServerCodecConfigurer 提供了一个设置所有编解码器的单一位置，请参阅 HTTP 消息编解码器。在客户端，可以在 WebClient.Builder 中更改所有编解码器的限制。

items.source: For Multipart parsing the maxInMemorySize property limits the size of non-file parts. For file parts, it determines the threshold at which the part is written to disk. For file parts written to disk, there is an additional maxDiskUsagePerPart property to limit the amount of disk space per part. There is also a maxParts property to limit the overall number of parts in a multipart request. To configure all three in WebFlux, you’ll need to supply a pre-configured instance of MultipartHttpMessageReader to ServerCodecConfigurer.
items.translation: 对于Multipart 解析，maxInMemorySize属性限制非文件部分的大小。对于文件部分，它确定将部分写入磁盘的阈值。对于写入磁盘的文件部分，还有一个额外的maxDiskUsagePerPart属性来限制每个部分使用的磁盘空间量。还有一个maxParts属性用于限制 Multipart 请求中的总体部分数量。要在 WebFlux 中配置这三项，您需要向ServerCodecConfigurer提供一个预配置的MultipartHttpMessageReader实例。

items.source: For the client side, there is a basic ClientHttpConnector contract to perform HTTP requests with non-blocking I/O and Reactive Streams back pressure, along with adapters for Reactor Netty, reactive Jetty HttpClient and Apache HttpComponents. The higher level WebClient used in applications builds on this basic contract.
items.translation: 对于客户端，存在一个基本的 ClientHttpConnector 契约，用于执行支持非阻塞 I/O 和 Reactive Streams 背压的 HTTP 请求，并提供了针对 Reactor Netty、响应式 Jetty HttpClient 以及 Apache HttpComponents 的适配器。应用程序中使用的高级 WebClient 构建于该基本契约之上。

items.source: To deploy as a WAR to a Servlet container instead, use AbstractReactiveWebInitializer, to adapt HttpHandler to a Servlet via ServletHttpHandlerAdapter.
items.translation: 若要改为以 WAR 形式部署到 Servlet 容器，请使用AbstractReactiveWebInitializer，通过ServletHttpHandlerAdapter将HttpHandler适配为Servlet。

items.source: In this case, the proxy has a prefix of /api/app1 and the server has a prefix of /app1. The proxy can send X-Forwarded-Prefix: /api/app1 to have the original prefix /api/app1 override the server prefix /app1.
items.translation: 在这种情况下，代理的前缀为 /api/app1，而服务器的前缀为 /app1。代理可以发送 X-Forwarded-Prefix: /api/app1，以使原始前缀 /api/app1 覆盖服务器前缀 /app1。

items.source: X-Forwarded-For: <address> is a de-facto standard header that is used to communicate the original InetSocketAddress of the client to a downstream server. For example, if a request is sent by a client at [fd00:fefe:1::4] to a proxy at 192.168.0.1, the "remote address" information contained in the HTTP request will reflect the actual address of the client, not the proxy.
items.translation: X-Forwarded-For: <address> 是一个事实上的标准标头，用于将客户端的原始 InetSocketAddress 信息传递给下游服务器。例如，如果来自 [fd00:fefe:1::4] 的客户端向位于 192.168.0.1 的代理发送请求，HTTP 请求中包含的“远程地址”信息将反映客户端的实际地址，而不是代理的地址。

items.source: DataBuffer abstracts different byte buffer representations (for example, Netty ByteBuf, java.nio.ByteBuffer, etc.) and is what all codecs work on. See Data Buffers and Codecs in the "Spring Core" section for more on this topic.
items.translation: DataBuffer 抽象了不同的字节缓冲区表示形式（例如，Netty ByteBuf、java.nio.ByteBuffer 等），是所有编解码器工作的基础。有关此主题的更多信息，请参阅“Spring Core”部分中的数据缓冲区和编解码器。

items.source: Encoder and Decoder are low level contracts to encode and decode content independent of HTTP.
items.translation: Encoder 和 Decoder 是用于对内容编码和解码的低级别接口，独立于 HTTP。

items.source: HttpMessageReader and HttpMessageWriter are contracts to encode and decode HTTP message content.
items.translation: HttpMessageReader 和 HttpMessageWriter 是用于编码和解码 HTTP 消息内容的接口。

items.source: An Encoder can be wrapped with EncoderHttpMessageWriter to adapt it for use in a web application, while a Decoder can be wrapped with DecoderHttpMessageReader.
items.translation: Encoder 可以与 EncoderHttpMessageWriter 组合使用，使其适用于 Web 应用程序，而 Decoder 可以与 DecoderHttpMessageReader 组合使用。

items.source: When decoding to a multi-value publisher (for example, Flux), each TokenBuffer is passed to the ObjectMapper as soon as enough bytes are received for a fully formed object. The input content can be a JSON array, or any line-delimited JSON format such as NDJSON, JSON Lines, or JSON Text Sequences.
items.translation: 解码到多值发布者（例如 Flux）时，一旦接收到足以形成完整对象的字节，每个 TokenBuffer 就会立即传递给 ObjectMapper。输入内容可以是 JSON 数组，也可以是任何行分隔式 JSON格式，例如 NDJSON、JSON Lines 或 JSON Text Sequences。

items.source: Once getMultipartData() is used, the original raw content can no longer be read from the request body. For this reason applications have to consistently use getMultipartData() for repeated, map-like access to parts, or otherwise rely on the SynchronossPartHttpMessageReader for a one-time access to Flux<Part>.
items.translation: 一旦使用 getMultipartData()，便无法再从请求体中读取原始内容。因此，应用程序必须始终一致地使用 getMultipartData() 进行类似映射的重复访问，或者依赖 SynchronossPartHttpMessageReader 进行一次性的 Flux<Part> 访问。

items.source: The ProtobufJsonDecoder and ProtobufJsonEncoder variants support reading and writing JSON documents to and from Protobuf messages. They require the "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util" dependency. Note, the JSON variants do not support reading stream of messages, see the javadoc of ProtobufJsonDecoder for more details.
items.translation: ProtobufJsonDecoder 和 ProtobufJsonEncoder 变体支持将 JSON 文档读写于 Protobuf 消息之间。它们需要 "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util" 依赖项。注意，JSON 变体不支持读取消息流，有关更多详细信息，请参阅 ProtobufJsonDecoder 的 javadoc。

items.source: Decoder and HttpMessageReader implementations that buffer some or all of the input stream can be configured with a limit on the maximum number of bytes to buffer in memory. In some cases buffering occurs because input is aggregated and represented as a single object — for example, a controller method with @RequestBody byte[], x-www-form-urlencoded data, and so on. Buffering can also occur with streaming, when splitting the input stream — for example, delimited text, a stream of JSON objects, and so on. For those streaming cases, the limit applies to the number of bytes associated with one object in the stream.
items.translation: Decoder 和 HttpMessageReader 实现若对输入流进行部分或全部缓冲，可配置内存中缓冲的最大字节数限制。在某些情况下，缓冲是因为输入被聚合并表示为单个对象——例如带有 @RequestBody byte[] 的控制器方法、x-www-form-urlencoded 数据等。缓冲也可能发生在流式处理中，当分割输入流时——例如定界文本、JSON 对象流等。对于这些流式情况，该限制适用于流中单个对象关联的字节数。

items.source: TRACE level logging generally follows the same principles as DEBUG (and for example also should not be a firehose) but can be used for debugging any issue. In addition, some log messages may show a different level of detail at TRACE vs DEBUG.
items.translation: TRACE 级别的日志记录通常遵循与 DEBUG 相同的原则（例如，也不应成为信息洪流），但可用于调试任何问题。此外，某些日志消息在 TRACE 和 DEBUG 级别下可能显示不同详细程度的信息。

items.source: Provide handling for exceptions from the chain of WebFilter instances and the target WebHandler. For more details, see Exceptions.
items.translation: 处理来自 WebFilter 实例链和目标 WebHandler 的异常。有关详细信息，请参阅异常。

items.source: The manager for WebSession instances exposed through a method on ServerWebExchange. DefaultWebSessionManager by default.
items.translation: 通过 ServerWebExchange 上的方法公开的 WebSession 实例的管理器。默认为 DefaultWebSessionManager。

items.source: For access to HttpMessageReader instances for parsing form data and multipart data that is then exposed through methods on ServerWebExchange. ServerCodecConfigurer.create() by default.
items.translation: 用于通过 ServerWebExchange 上的方法访问用于解析表单数据和多部分数据的 HttpMessageReader 实例。默认情况下，由 ServerCodecConfigurer.create() 创建。

items.source: The resolver for LocaleContext exposed through a method on ServerWebExchange. AcceptHeaderLocaleContextResolver by default.
items.translation: 通过 ServerWebExchange 上的方法暴露的 LocaleContext 解析器，默认为 AcceptHeaderLocaleContextResolver。

items.source: ForwardedHeaderTransformer is a component that modifies the host, port, and scheme of the request, based on forwarded headers, and then removes those headers. If you declare it as a bean with the name forwardedHeaderTransformer, it will be detected and used.
items.translation: ForwardedHeaderTransformer 是一个组件，它根据转发头修改请求的主机、端口和方案，然后删除这些头。如果您将其声明为名为 forwardedHeaderTransformer 的 Bean，它将被检测并使用。

items.source: See the section on CORS and the CORS WebFilter for more details.
items.translation: 请参阅CORS部分以及CORS WebFilter以获取更多信息。

items.source: ClientCodecConfigurer and ServerCodecConfigurer are typically used to configure and customize the codecs to use in an application. See the section on configuring HTTP message codecs.
items.translation: ClientCodecConfigurer 和 ServerCodecConfigurer 通常用于配置和自定义应用程序中使用的编解码器。请参阅关于配置HTTP 消息编解码器的章节。

items.source: For a multi-value publisher with a streaming media type such as application/x-ndjson or application/stream+x-jackson-smile, encode, write, and flush each value individually using a line-delimited JSON format. Other streaming media types may be registered with the encoder.
items.translation: 对于具有流式媒体类型（如application/x-ndjson或application/stream+x-jackson-smile）的多值发布者，请使用行分隔 JSON格式逐个编码、写入并刷新每个值。编码器可以注册其他流式媒体类型。

items.source: FormHttpMessageReader and FormHttpMessageWriter support decoding and encoding application/x-www-form-urlencoded content.
items.translation: FormHttpMessageReader 和 FormHttpMessageWriter 支持解码和编码 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 内容。

items.source: ProtobufEncoder and ProtobufDecoder supporting decoding and encoding "application/x-protobuf", "application/octet-stream" and "application/vnd.google.protobuf" content for com.google.protobuf.Message types. They also support stream of values if content is received/sent with the "delimited" parameter along the content type (like "application/x-protobuf;delimited=true"). This requires the "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java" library, version 3.29 and higher.
items.translation: ProtobufEncoder 和 ProtobufDecoder 支持对 com.google.protobuf.Message 类型的 "application/x-protobuf"、"application/octet-stream" 和 "application/vnd.google.protobuf" 内容进行解码和编码。如果内容类型中带有 "delimited" 参数（例如 "application/x-protobuf;delimited=true"），它们还支持流式值传输。这需要 "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java" 库，版本需为 3.29 或更高。

items.source: There are security considerations for forwarded headers since an application cannot know if the headers were added by a proxy, as intended, or by a malicious client. items.source: When streaming to the HTTP response (for example, text/event-stream, application/x-ndjson), it is important to send data periodically, in order to reliably detect a disconnected client sooner rather than later. Such a send could be a comment-only, empty SSE event or any other "no-op" data that would effectively serve as a heartbeat.
items.translation: 当向 HTTP 响应流式传输数据（例如 text/event-stream、application/x-ndjson）时，定期发送数据非常重要，以便尽早可靠地检测到已断开的客户端。此类发送可以是一个仅包含注释的空 SSE 事件，或任何其他“无操作”数据，其作用相当于心跳信号。

items.source: DataBuffer is the representation for a byte buffer in WebFlux. The Spring Core part of this reference has more on that in the section on Data Buffers and Codecs. The key point to understand is that on some servers like Netty, byte buffers are pooled and reference counted, and must be released when consumed to avoid memory leaks.
items.translation: DataBuffer 是 WebFlux 中字节缓冲区的表示形式。本参考文档的 Spring Core 部分在Data Buffers and Codecs章节中有更多相关内容。需要理解的关键点是，在某些服务器（如 Netty）上，字节缓冲区是池化并引用计数的，因此在消费时必须释放它们，以避免内存泄漏。

items.source: WebFlux applications generally do not need to be concerned with such issues, unless they consume or produce data buffers directly, as opposed to relying on codecs to convert to and from higher level objects, or unless they choose to create custom codecs.
